title: peach candle spiral breathes through the break
story: Tadow sits at about 62 feel (tracker 123 bpm eighths; lag 31). The groove is a dense snare and kick grid: each kick (dark, centroid < 0.16) thickens the arms, each snare (bright) twists the spiral and lifts the palette, and the big hit at 2362 opens the spiral from three arms to four. At 2508 the drums thin and the sax and keys take over: the spiral breathes between 0.55 and 0.75 on each two-bar phrase, the hue swings per bar, the colour desaturates, and the density thins. The sparse snares and kicks still carry their pulses, and at 2930 the drums come back on the four-arm spiral with a contrast lift that settles into the post-roll.
